set.body:
Source: PRD.html sections 8, 10, 11, 13, and requirements F-02 through F-08.

Scope:
- Implement fixed-executable argument-vector command execution with sanitized environment, deadlines, and concurrent bounded stdout/stderr capture.
- Discover Slurm version, cluster, JSON data-parser, accounting, array, and relevant site capabilities.
- Implement sbatch submission, squeue observation, sacct accounting, focused scontrol diagnostics, and explicit scancel acknowledgement.
- Support opaque inline and staged scripts with exit-only results.
- Assign separate private stdout/stderr paths and provide bounded byte-cursor log reads.
- Build versioned JSON codecs, strict parsable fallbacks, raw evidence retention, and deterministic fake process/scheduler fixtures.

Acceptance:
- One local opaque-script path runs submit -> observe -> logs -> accounting -> terminal diagnosis.
- Rejection, invocation failure, parse failure, empty query, stale observation, and workload failure remain distinct.
- Log absence while pending is WaitingForFile, not failure.
- Interpreter passes the initial scheduler and stream-finalization laws.
set.title: P1: Implement the truthful local Slurm CLI vertical slice
